claim: ADR 0240: CLAIMS.jsonl and v3.0-TECH-DEBT.md are frozen (each file's line count equals its pin in check_decision_claims.sh, CLAIMS ends in the FROZEN sentinel row, the last TECH-DEBT ## heading is the FROZEN section), the runner reads claims.d/ fragments and calls _debt_frozen.py, the runner test calls the debt self-test, and both parsers' self-tests pass. This row lives in claims.d/, so it being counted at all is the proof that fragments are read.
verify: n=$(sed -n 's/^CLAIMS_FROZEN_LINES=\([0-9]*\)$/\1/p' scripts/check_decision_claims.sh); d=$(sed -n 's/^DEBT_FROZEN_LINES=\([0-9]*\)$/\1/p' scripts/check_decision_claims.sh); [ -n "$n" ] && [ -n "$d" ] && [ "$(wc -l < .planning/decisions/CLAIMS.jsonl)" -eq "$n" ] && [ "$(wc -l < .planning/v3.0-TECH-DEBT.md)" -eq "$d" ] && tail -n 1 .planning/decisions/CLAIMS.jsonl | grep -q '^{"_comment": "FROZEN' && grep '^## ' .planning/v3.0-TECH-DEBT.md | tail -n 1 | grep -q '^## FROZEN' && grep -q -- '--fragments "$CLAIMS_FRAGMENTS"' scripts/check_decision_claims.sh && grep -q '_debt_frozen.py' scripts/check_decision_claims.sh && grep -q '_debt_frozen.py" --self-test' scripts/test_check_decision_claims.sh && python3 scripts/_claims_parse.py --self-test > /dev/null && python3 scripts/_debt_frozen.py --self-test > /dev/null
